paths.title: Pages to check
paths.description: Paths on your website (for example /, /shop, /about); the home page is always checked, at most 20 pages.

titleMin.title: Shortest good title (characters)
titleMin.description: A page title shorter than this is flagged to improve.

titleMax.title: Longest good title (characters)
titleMax.description: A page title longer than this is flagged: search results cut long titles (about 60 characters on Google).

descriptionMin.title: Shortest good meta description (characters)
descriptionMin.description: A meta description shorter than this is flagged to improve.

descriptionMax.title: Longest good meta description (characters)
descriptionMax.description: A meta description longer than this is flagged: search results cut long ones (about 160 characters on Google).
